page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top centre; page number top right; signature F 2 at the foot centre-left. No margin notes.

main_text.p: I. Onus vectigalis exteris potius quam indigenis incubiturum, propter vectigal aucto irum ab indigenis Serici pretio, quod illi, ro carere non possint, persolvere teneantur. Illi contra id improbabant, ea imprimis ad-ea ratione, quod aucto propter vectigalia apolitani Serici pretio, commercium ejus ræfens florentissimum omnino turbandum ligandumque crederetur. Cum enim in Ditionibus ejusdem Serici etiam copia se rret, quod tributis haud oneratum ac inde viliori pretio redemptum, ab aliis po-impofterum petituri sint quàm à Neopo-lis.
main_text.head: DECRETUM.
main_text.p: ter multas altercationes prior tamen sen-ia pervicit.
main_text.head: EVENTUS.
main_text.p: ongé verò ille improsperrimus fuit. Seri-enim ab exteris mercatoribus viliori pre-liunde mox est petitum. Qua ratione com-cia hæc Neapolitanorum omnino turbata, us florentibus & vectigali non impofito, fuissent Neapolitanorum magis magif-n dies opes, quarum potius quam serici ine tandem exigi potuisset optimum tri-im.
main_text.head: JUDICIUM.
main_text.p: x indigenis & nativis Regnorum bonis, ea exteri desiderant, & aliunde peti haud pos-funt:

page.notes: Printed text is faint and damaged at the left and right edges of the column; several line-initial letters are cut off, so readings such as "ter", "ia", "ongé", "x indigenis" and "lis" are partial. Items marked by reconstruction in the first paragraph ("ab indigenis Serici", "impofterum") are uncertain and not marked with [?] due to scan quality. The word "fuit" after "improsperrimus" and "Neapolitanorum" appear as printed.
